cases.sentence: Павел встретил иудея по имени Акила, уроженца ___.
cases.translation: Paul met a certain Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus.
cases.explain: The genitive case expresses origin or source (уроженца Понта — a native of Pontus).

cases.sentence: кесарь Клавдий приказал всем иудеям покинуть ___.
cases.translation: Caesar Claudius ordered all the Jews to leave Rome.
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'покинуть' (to leave) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: У них было одно ремесло с ___.
cases.translation: They practiced the same trade with Paul.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Каждую субботу он рассуждал в синагоге с иудеями и ___.
cases.translation: Every Sabbath he reasoned in the synagogue with Jews and Greeks.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case, and the plural form matches the context.

cases.sentence: Начальник синагоги Крисп и все его ___ поверили в Господа.
cases.translation: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, and all his household believed in the Lord.
cases.explain: Домашние is the plural nominative form, acting as the subject with поверили (believed).

cases.sentence: Господь сказал Павлу в видении, оставляя в стороне времена ___.
cases.translation: The Lord said to Paul in a vision, overlooking the times of ignorance.
cases.explain: The noun phrase 'времена невежества' uses the genitive 'невежества' to express the nature of the times.

cases.sentence: Аполлос был научен пути ___ и говорил очень горячо и убедительно.
cases.translation: Apollos was instructed in the way of the Lord and spoke with great fervor and accuracy.
cases.explain: The phrase 'пути Господа' (the way of the Lord) uses the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Аполлос хотел идти в Ахайю, и братья написали ___ с просьбой принять его.
cases.translation: Apollos wanted to go to Achaia, and the brothers wrote a letter requesting that he be received.
cases.explain: The verb 'написали' (wrote) is transitive and requires the accusative case for 'письмо' (letter).

reading.ru: Павел встретил иудея по имени Акила, уроженца Понте.
reading.question: Who did Paul meet when he came to Corinth?
options: A Jewish man named Aquila from Pontus
reading.correct: A Jewish man named Aquila from Pontus
reading.explain: The text identifies Aquila as 'иудея по имени Акила, уроженца Понте' — a Jew named Aquila from Pontus.

reading.ru: У них было одно ремесло с Павлом, они изготавливали палатки.
reading.question: What trade did Paul practice with Aquila and Priscilla?
reading.explain: The text says 'они изготавливали палатки' — they made tents.

reading.ru: Когда же они стали препятствовать ему и оскорблять его, он отряхнул пыль с одежды и сказал им, Вы сами повинны в своей гибели.
reading.question: What did Paul do when the Jews opposed and insulted him?
options: He shook the dust off his clothes and said they were responsible for their own ruin
He reported them to the Roman authorities
reading.correct: He shook the dust off his clothes and said they were responsible for their own ruin
reading.explain: The text describes: 'он отряхнул пыль с одежды и сказал им, Вы сами повинны в своей гибели' — he shook dust off his garments and told them they were responsible.

reading.ru: Однажды ночью Господь сказал Павлу в видении, «Не бойся, продолжай говорить и не умолкай».
reading.question: What encouragement did the Lord give to Paul in a vision at night?
options: Don't be afraid, keep speaking and don't be silent
Stop preaching and return to tentmaking
reading.correct: Don't be afraid, keep speaking and don't be silent
reading.explain: The Lord's message was 'Не бойся, продолжай говорить и не умолкай' — Don't be afraid, continue speaking, don't stop.

reading.ru: Крисп, начальник синагоги, и все его домашние поверили в Господа.
reading.question: Who were the first people in Corinth to believe in the Lord?
options: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, and his entire household
reading.correct: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, and his entire household
reading.explain: The text states 'Крисп, начальник синагоги, и все его домашние поверили в Господа' — Crispus the synagogue ruler and all his household believed.

reading.ru: Аполлос было научен пути Господа и говорил очень горячо и убедительно, правильно уча об Иисусе.
reading.question: How is Apollos described in the text?
options: He was instructed in the way of the Lord, spoke with fervor and accuracy, teaching correctly about Jesus
reading.correct: He was instructed in the way of the Lord, spoke with fervor and accuracy, teaching correctly about Jesus
reading.explain: The text describes Apollos as 'научен пути Господа' and 'говорил очень горячо и убедительно' and 'правильно уча об Иисусе' — instructed, fervent, and accurate in his teaching.
